blocks.heading: I'm ready to embark on a cruise. Where can I find the latest Princess Cruises deals and promotions?
blocks.text: Visit the Cruise Deals & Promotions page for the latest sales and special offers. New offers are introduced regularly so it's a great place to start when planning your vacation and looking for ways to maximize value. Once you've booked, you'll also receive notifications about special offers on shore excursions, drink packages, specialty dining, spa services, and more.

blocks.heading: Can I get a better deal by planning carefully in advance, or is it better to take advantage of last minute deals?
blocks.text: Both strategies have advantages. Planning ahead can help you take advantage of promotional fares and secure your preferred itinerary before availability becomes limited. Last minute deals can also offer savings if your desired sailing hasn't sold out. Travelers with flexible schedules often find the best value, especially outside peak holiday and summer travel periods.

blocks.heading: Which cruise destinations offer the best value?
blocks.text: The best value depends on your travel preferences, budget, and timing. Popular destinations such as the Caribbean, Alaska and the Mediterranean offer a wide range of itineraries and experiences at different price points throughout the year. blocks.text: There are plenty of ways to get more bang for your buck when you sail on a Princess Cruises vacation. Every ship in the fleet offers a range of delicious complimentary dining and drink options, but you can elevate your culinary experience by adding a Princess Plus® or Princess Premier® package to your cruise fare. blocks.heading: Is Princess Cruises the cheapest cruise line?
blocks.text: While Princess Cruises may not always offer the lowest fare, many guests choose Princess for its overall value. With dining, entertainment, onboard activities, and destination-rich itineraries included in the vacation experience, Princess delivers exceptional value both onboard and ashore.

blocks.heading: I'm ready to embark on a cruise. Where can I find the latest Princess Cruises deals and promotions?
blocks.text: Visit the Cruise Deals & Promotions page for the latest sales and special offers. New offers are introduced regularly so it's a great place to start when planning your vacation and looking for ways to maximize value. Once you've booked, you'll also receive notifications about special offers on shore excursions, drink packages, specialty dining, spa services, and more.

blocks.heading: Can I get a better deal by planning carefully in advance, or is it better to take advantage of last minute deals?
blocks.text: Both strategies have advantages. Planning ahead can help you take advantage of promotional fares and secure your preferred itinerary before availability becomes limited. Last minute deals can also offer savings if your desired sailing hasn't sold out. Travelers with flexible schedules often find the best value, especially outside peak holiday and summer travel periods.

blocks.heading: Which cruise destinations offer the best value?
blocks.text: The best value depends on your travel preferences, budget, and timing. Popular destinations such as the Caribbean, Alaska and the Mediterranean offer a wide range of itineraries and experiences at different price points throughout the year. blocks.text: There are plenty of ways to get more bang for your buck when you sail on a Princess Cruises vacation. Every ship in the fleet offers a range of delicious complimentary dining and drink options, but you can elevate your culinary experience by adding a Princess Plus® or Princess Premier® package to your cruise fare. blocks.heading: Is Princess Cruises the cheapest cruise line?
blocks.text: While Princess Cruises may not always offer the lowest fare, many guests choose Princess for its overall value. With dining, entertainment, onboard activities, and destination-rich itineraries included in the vacation experience, Princess delivers exceptional value both onboard and ashore.

blocks.heading: What are cruise credits?
blocks.text: Think of Princess Cruise Credits like store credit that you can use on your Princess purchase. There are different types of credits: Future Cruise Credit Future Cruise Deposit Onboard Credit It helps to understand the differences between these, as you get them for different reasons and they can be used for different items.

blocks.heading: About future cruise credit
blocks.text: It’s now easier than ever to use your Future Cruise Credit (FCC)! You can apply it toward your next cruise fare or contribute to a travel companion’s fare on your booking. blocks.heading: About future cruise deposit
blocks.text: You can purchase a Future Cruise Deposit (FCD) on board as part of our Future Cruise Deposit Program. The Future Cruise Deposit is a reduced deposit of $100 per person that secures a booking until final payment and gives the guest up to $150 Onboard Credit! You’ll have up to a year to book your cruise with your preferred Travel Advisor or Cruise Vacation Planner or directly through Princess. If yo

blocks.heading: NEW Finding and using future cruise credits and deposits
blocks.text: Your Future Cruise Credit and Future Cruise Deposit will appear under your profile in My Princess® Circle Savings as a payment type. In some cases you may see a discount type. The difference? Discounts are slightly more restrictive and can only be used toward your cruise fare, not that of your travel companions or any add-ons. Credits may take up to 60 days to show up in your account, and you’ll g

blocks.heading: About onboard credit
blocks.text: You can use Onboard Credit to purchase products or services once you’re on the ship. This type of credit is also called "onboard spending money" and is typically part of promotional offers, such as our Limited Time Offers or our Future Cruise Deposit Program. You can apply Onboard Credit to: Shore Excursions Beverages Items from The Shops of Princess Services at the Lotus Spa®

blocks.heading: Redeeming onboard credit
blocks.text: Before you sail, your Onboard Credit can be used to purchase shore excursions online through Manage Booking. When you check out, we’ll automatically apply your credit to the payment due unless you uncheck the "onboard credit applied" box on the "Reservation Summary" screen. Once on board, you can use Onboard Credit on shore excursions, specialty dining, spa treatments, beverage packages and more.
